an8.41:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
an8.41:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an8.41:2.1: Aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgato bhikkhave uposatho upavuttho mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso mahājutiko mahāvipphāro.
an8.41:2.2: Kathaṃ upavuttho ca bhikkhave aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgato uposatho mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso mahājutiko mahāvipphāro? 3.
an8.41:2.4: ‘yāvajīvaṃ arahanto pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā nihitadaṇḍā nihitasatthā lajjī dayāpannā sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharanti,
an8.41:2.5: ahaṃ p' ajja imañ ca rattiṃ imañ ca divasaṃ pāṇātipātaṃ pahāya pāṇātipātā paṭivirato nihitadaṇḍo nihitasattho lajjī dayāpanno sabbapāṇabhūtahitānukampī viharāmi,
an8.41:2.6: iminā pi aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi, uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissatī' ti.
an8.41:3.1: ‘Yāvajīvaṃ arahanto adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭiviratā dinnādāyī dinnapāṭikaṅkhī athenena sucibhūtena attanā viharanti,
an8.41:3.2: ahaṃ p' ajja imañ ca rattiṃ imañ ca divasaṃ adinnādānaṃ pahāya adinnādānā paṭivirato dinnādāyī dinnapāṭikaṅkhī athenena sucibhūtena attanā viharāmi,
an8.41:3.3: iminā pi aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi, uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissatī' ti.
an8.41:4.1: ‘Yāvajīvaṃ arahanto abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī ārācārī viratā methunā gāmadhammā,
an8.41:4.2: ahaṃ p' ajja imañ ca rattiṃ imañ ca divasaṃ abrahmacariyaṃ pahāya brahmacārī ārācārī virato methunā gāmadhammā,
an8.41:4.3: iminā pi aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi, uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissatī' ti.
an8.41:5.1: ‘Yāvajīvaṃ arahanto musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭiviratā saccavādī saccasandhā ṭhetā paccayikā avisaṃvādakā lokassa,
an8.41:5.2: ahaṃ p' ajja imañ ca rattiṃ imañ ca divasaṃ musāvādaṃ pahāya musāvādā paṭivirato saccavādī saccasandho ṭheto paccayiko avisaṃvādako lokassa,
an8.41:5.3: iminā pi aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi, uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissatī' ti.
an8.41:6.2: ahaṃ p' ajja imañ ca rattiṃ imañ ca divasaṃ surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānaṃ pahāya surāmerayamajjapamādaṭṭhānā paṭivirato,
an8.41:6.3: iminā pi aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi, uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissatī' ti.
an8.41:7.2: ahaṃ p' ajja imañ ca rattiṃ imañ ca divasaṃ ekabhattiko rattūparato virato vikālabhojanā,
an8.41:7.3: iminā pi aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi, uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissatī' ti.
an8.41:8.2: ahaṃ p' ajja imañ ca rattiṃ imañ ca divasaṃ naccagītavāditavisūkadassanamālāgandhavilepanadhāraṇamaṇḍanavibhūsanaṭṭhānā paṭivirato,
an8.41:8.3: iminā pi aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi, uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissatī' ti.
an8.41:9.1: ‘Yāvajīvaṃ arahanto uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ pahāya uccāsayanamahāsayanā paṭiviratā nīcaseyyaṃ kappenti mañcake vā tiṇasanthārake vā,
an8.41:9.2: ahaṃ p' ajja imañ ca rattiṃ imañ ca divasaṃ uccāsayanamahāsayanaṃ pahāya uccāsayanamahāsayanā paṭivirato nīcaseyyaṃ kappemi mañcake vā tiṇasanthārake vā,
an8.41:9.3: iminā pi aṅgena arahataṃ anukaromi, uposatho ca me upavuttho bhavissatī' ti.
an8.41:10.1: Evaṃ upavuttho kho bhikkhave aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgato uposatho mahapphalo hoti mahānisaṃso mahājutiko mahāvipphāro
